items.a: The truck and trailer will be bought and registered to the private individual who runs this experiment and has chosen to stay anonymous. Contributions are voluntary gifts: they give no ownership, equity or returns.

items.q: What if we do not reach $130,000?
items.a: The public goal stays fixed at $130,000 and progress is always visible. We are optimistic, but it is not guaranteed. Contributions are non-refundable. Any change of plan is published in the change log.
It is shown separately as POST-GOAL FUNDS and is intended for children who are orphaned or in unsafe care. Recipients and amounts will be published with receipts.

items.q: Is this a charity or an investment?
items.a: Neither. It is an internet experiment: no equity, no returns.

items.q: Can the AI move the money?
items.a: No. The AI writes updates and reports. Wallets are controlled by a human and no keys are on this site.

items.q: How do I verify my payment?
items.a: Use the explorer button next to the address, or paste your transaction hash into any block explorer. Verified entries appear in the public ledger.
